_about: The fourteen playable characters. Safe content: names, professions and genders are locked (character roster, 8 Sep 2026). Traces follow Jon's drawings, decided 8 Oct 2026 (this list supersedes sirwin-manor-traces.md): the files live in play/public/traces/<trace>.png. Bios are the one-line display lines. Professor is never in the random pool: Jonathan and Susan Kostington play themselves.

characters.name: Preston White
characters.bio: You write for the local paper. You are always taking notes, including now.

characters.name: Roger Arms
characters.bio: Retired. You were not asked about this, and you are going to explain it anyway.

characters.name: Dorothy Rye
characters.bio: Up since four. You have opinions about everyone else's bread.

characters.name: Prudence Ledger
characters.bio: You mind the town's money. You know precisely what everyone here is worth, and you would never say.

characters.name: Iris DeVine
characters.bio: You arrange flowers for weddings and funerals alike. You charge more for funerals.

characters.name: Hayward Barnes
characters.bio: You farm the land just past the gate. You have brought vegetables nobody asked for.

characters.name: Ignatius Fume
characters.bio: You conduct experiments. Several of them are still running at home, unattended.

characters.name: Madame Opal Mourningstone
characters.bio: You commune with the departed for a modest fee. Results vary. The fee does not.

characters.name: Jasper Steeps
characters.bio: You serve coffee to the entire town. You know what everyone drinks, and what they are like before they've had it.

characters.name: Constance Vayne
characters.bio: You document your life for an audience. You have already posted twice this evening.

characters.name: Dr. Paige Shushwell
characters.bio: You run the library. You know what everyone borrows, and you have drawn conclusions.

characters.name: Dr. Bartholomew Leech
characters.bio: You are the town physician. Your methods are traditional and you will not hear otherwise.

characters.name: Prof. Jonathan Kostington
characters.bio: You lecture on subjects nobody asked about. It is your dog's birthday and you have prepared remarks.

characters.name: Prof. Susan Kostington
characters.bio: You lecture at the same institution as your husband, in a field you consider considerably more rigorous.

_affection: Starting-affection modifiers per profession, -2 to +2 (bio worksheet matrix, 9 Sep 2026). Sir Irwin is absent on purpose: always 5. Professor is flat zero pending Jon's call (flat zero vs mildly negative). Doctor was not in the original matrix; the row below is a default to confirm.
